title: ALL CAPS: THE HISTORY OF THE AMERICAN BASEBALL HAT
chaptersLine: Forty-plus chapters drafted, plus an introduction and a closing coda.
spanLine: From before the Civil War to the drops of 2026.
thisWeek: Revision ran right through the start of the month, with a fresh voice pass moving across the manuscript.
A decades-old naming question got settled: how two ball clubs ended up spelling a word the way they still do.
A new interview lane opened, with a Negro Leagues and Black Fives voice signing on for a recorded sit-down.
chapterHighlights: The one season a legendary blue franchise traded away its signature color, and the cap that proves it happened.
How a newspaper's need for a short headline handed two ball clubs the spelling they still wear.
A Negro Leagues thread the book keeps circling back to as a story of memory and belonging.
An East Los Angeles boulevard where the right cap has always been a form of belonging.
